name: SK6812MINI-HS addressable RGB LED
description: OPSCO SK6812MINI-HS, a 3.5 x 3.7 mm RGB LED with its driver inside (the ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1's): 24-bit colour received on DIN in the WS2812's single-wire code, 0 and 1 told apart by the high's length, the rest passed on at DOUT, latched by a low of more than 80 us.

pins.name: VDD
pins.doc: Supply, 3.7 to 5.5 V by its datasheet; the ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1 runs it from 3.3 V

pins.name: DOUT
pins.doc: Data out to the next LED's DIN (not connected on the ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1)

t_reset.doc: Low time that latches a frame: more than 80 us (Trst)

t_bit.doc: A high this long or longer is a 1: between the longest 0 (T0H max 0.4 us) and the shortest 1 (T1H min 0.58 us)

t0h.doc: A reshaped 0's high at DOUT (T0H typical)

t1h.doc: A reshaped 1's high at DOUT (T1H typical)

v_on.doc: VDD below which the part is dark and takes no data: assumed (see the fidelity)

functional.claims: The WS2812's single-wire code on DIN told apart at 0.49 us (between the datasheet's longest 0, 0.4 us, and shortest 1, 0.58 us); the first 24 bits after a reset kept (GRB, MSB first), the rest passed on at DOUT reshaped to 0.32 / 0.64 us highs; a low of more than 80 us latches the colour; off at power-up; dark and deaf below 3.0 V.
omissions: the light itself (colours reported as the 8-bit PWM levels, no intensity per channel, nor its dimming below the rated supply)
supply current (up to 12 mA per colour) and its voltage drop
the input threshold's dependence on VDD (VIH 0.7 VDD, VIL 0.3 VDD) beyond the pin model's levels
the reshaping's delay (TPLH, TPHL up to 500 ns)

the supply below which it stops: the datasheet rates 3.7 to 5.5 V and gives no lower limit of operation; Espressif runs it from 3.3 V on the ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1, where it lights, so the model takes data down to 3.0 V, an assumption
